notes.title: Dev Update 3: Tearing and Ripping
notes.content:
Weeks are full of merry laughter is what we all wish developing a game was. There hasn’t been any major issues or any real issues at hand, but its always disheartening to see having to scrap some of your already made work. Even if it is inevitable. 

This time we had to scrap the in game UI as it didn’t fulfill its whole purpose. The idea was to have a combination of a steering while and old handheld console as the UI in game; A month or two removed from its inception it is now gone, awaiting its follow up. 

On a positive note we have had marked improvements on some online functionalities. Quite a few lines have been revamped to improve the experience. Now we can finally move on to adding more functions. In addition to the UI upgrade we upgrade our corner system, especially the effects of reaching a corner. There is hope we can show some preliminary footage of our upgrades in the coming week. 
Another thank you to everyone who is here and have another great week.
